content_blocks.text: The Procurement Reform (Scotland) Act 2014 contains the sustainable procurement duty. This states that it is the duty of the public sector organisation to consider, before carrying out a regulated procurement, how the procurement process can promote innovation (when it is relevant and proportionate to do so).

content_blocks.text: The Impact and Value of the Sustainable Procurement Duty report received buyer feedback that more support for innovation was required, whilst responses to the Supplier Survey showed that considering innovation in procurement exercises could be improved.
